import subprocess
import sys
from collections import Counter

import yaml


def front(path):
    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    assert text.startswith("---\n")
    end = text.index("\n---\n", 4)
    return yaml.safe_load(text[4:end])


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


a3 = front("governance/adoption/A3-target-path-map.md")
a4 = front("governance/adoption/A4-batched-plan.md")
tracked_cli = set(git("ls-files", "-z", "cli").split("\0")) - {""}
base = "21e8bf0e"
tracked_all = set(git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "-z", "HEAD").split("\0")) - {""}
blobs = {}
for line in git("ls-tree", "-r", "HEAD", "cli").splitlines():
    meta, path = line.split("\t", 1)
    blobs[path] = meta.split()[2]

arts = a3["artefacts"]
paths = [a["path"] for a in arts]
print("A3 entries:", len(arts), "unique:", len(set(paths)))
print("A3 actions:", dict(Counter(a["action"] for a in arts)))
non_keep = {a["path"]: a for a in arts if a["action"] != "KEEP"}
print("tracked cli files:", len(tracked_cli))
print("non-KEEP == tracked cli:", set(non_keep) == tracked_cli)
print("non-KEEP outside cli/:", sorted(p for p in non_keep if not p.startswith("cli/")))
print("cli/ entries with KEEP:", sorted(a["path"] for a in arts if a["path"].startswith("cli/") and a["action"] == "KEEP"))
print("non-KEEP action set:", sorted({a["action"] for a in non_keep.values()}))
print("non-KEEP batch set:", sorted({str(a.get("batch")) for a in non_keep.values()}))
print("non-KEEP authority set:", sorted({str(a.get("authority")) for a in non_keep.values()}))
print("A3 blob mismatches vs HEAD:", sorted(p for p, a in non_keep.items() if a.get("blob") != blobs.get(p)))
print("extra keys on KEEP entries:", sorted({k for a in arts if a["action"] == "KEEP" for k in a} - {"path", "action"}))
head_names = set(paths)
print("tracked at HEAD not in A3:", sorted(tracked_all - head_names)[:20], len(tracked_all - head_names))
print("in A3 not tracked at HEAD:", sorted(head_names - tracked_all)[:20], len(head_names - tracked_all))

batches = a4["batches"]
print("A4 batches:", len(batches), [b["batch"] for b in batches], [b.get("rollback_point") for b in batches])
b = batches[0]["artefacts"]
bp = [x["path"] for x in b]
print("A4 batch-1 entries:", len(bp), "unique:", len(set(bp)))
print("A4 batch-1 == tracked cli:", set(bp) == tracked_cli)
print("A4 actions:", dict(Counter(x["action"] for x in b)))
print("A4 blob mismatches vs HEAD:", sorted(x["path"] for x in b if x.get("blob") != blobs.get(x["path"])))
print("A4 dependents:", a4.get("dependents"), "retirements:", a4.get("retirements"))
print("A4 stands_on:", a4.get("stands_on"), "path_map_hash:", a4.get("path_map_hash"))
print("A3 stands_on:", a3.get("stands_on"))
ext = Counter(p.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if "." in p.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] else "(none)" for p in tracked_cli)
print("cli by extension:", dict(ext))
top = Counter("/".join(p.split("/")[:2]) for p in tracked_cli)
print("cli by subdir:", dict(top))

- The shell's `grep` is a wrapper that missed real matches (`README.md:9` and `path-map.yaml:108`), so every search the verdict rests on was repeated with GNU grep.
